bestFor: Terminal-centric developers who want a local agent and a known git workflow
skipIf: You want a GUI and a vendor to invoice
keyFeatures: Clean automatic git commits per edit
Works with any major LLM API or local model
limitations: No GUI or hosted SaaS SSO

summary: Open-source pair programmer in the terminal. You bring the API keys.
body: Aider is the adult in the room if you are tired of $20 skins on the same models. It edits, commits, and stays in git. You will spend time on model choice and context. That is the point. There is no cracked “Pro.” There is an open-source repo and your own API bill.
notes: Start with a cheap model, then spend on hard tasks
Excellent teaching tool for how agents touch git
Not a hosted SaaS with SSO
